name: live_doc_cowrite
task: Co-write a document live by voice — the flagship demo. The user wants echoecho to start a doc, take their dictated content into it, extend it on request, and read it back. Success means real file writes land in the workspace and echoecho narrates progress instead of refusing or stalling.
turns: let's write a short thank you speech together and save it in a doc called speech dot md
start with: thank you all for an incredible year, we shipped more than we ever have
now add a line thanking the volunteers by name, Maya and Jordan
read me what we have so far
success_criteria: echoecho dispatches a background task (agent.run or doc.edit) to create speech.md rather than refusing
speech.md exists in the workspace and contains the dictated opening line about an incredible year
speech.md thanks Maya and Jordan after the second request
when asked to read it back, echoecho uses read_artifact and speaks the actual content of speech.md
echoecho acknowledges each request briefly before dispatching and never claims it cannot write documents
red_flags: claims it cannot write, save, or create documents
says the content was saved when no file write actually happened
reads back content that does not match the actual file
goes silent or stalls instead of dispatching work
